beats.summary: Michael gets gum stuck in his hair and tries to remove it with peanut butter and ice cream sandwich.

evidence.snippet: Michael: I got gum in my hair.
Pam: We have peanut butter in the kitchen.

beats.summary: Michael expresses frustration about unsuccessful dating experiences.

evidence.snippet: Michael: I will be honest; the dating has not been going well.

beats.summary: Ryan announces a mandatory Saturday workday to re-enter sales for the website.

evidence.snippet: Ryan: Yes, I'm having the Scranton branch come in on one Saturday so they can re-enter sales that they made on the phone as sales that were made by the website

beats.summary: Employees express concerns about the Dunder Mifflin Infinity website and its social networking feature.

evidence.snippet: Stanley: I don't like when my clients call me to help them use the website, I'm not seeing commissions on that.
Ryan: Yes, the social networking feature of the Dunder Mifflin Infinity website was infiltrated by sexual predators.

beats.summary: Michael plans a night out in New York with Ryan, Dwight, and others to meet girls and party.

evidence.snippet: Michael: Ok, Dwight grab your stuff, we're going to New York to party with Ryan and to meet girls.
Andy: Oh yes! Count me in dudes. I am in some serious need of some bro' time.

beats.summary: Jim suggests staying late to avoid coming in on Saturday, and the group supports the idea.

evidence.snippet: Jim: So I caught everyone before they left and I told them my idea, and they loved it.
